proposals.why: The two antecedents are separate survey measures and either can move with the other held, which rules out a multiplicative form. They no longer overlap either: the clarity-only index is out of the core, and prosocial_mission reaches performance only through perceived_work_meaningfulness rather than both ways round, so the contributions are independent and additive is what the evidence settles.

What is left to discretion is what was conceded, net of the agency cost, less the pinned-down side and less the whole of the principal cost. Signed contributions that add, not a product. The multiplicative reading belonged to the single-channel version, where measurement modulated the allocation; measurement now divides it between the two channels instead, which is the role the imported model declares for it.

Two vulnerabilities, either of which calls for control rights on its own. Stoelhorst and Vishwanathan join them with OR rather than AND, so they add rather than multiply: a relation exposed to shirking alone still needs them.
